semantic_objects: residual stream activation; normalization layer input
relation_statement: The value added through the identity path at the block output must equal the un-normalized block input under pre-LN sequential blocks.
observable_signal: checksum of the residual tensor before the norm differs from the tensor actually added at the block output; block output diverges from a reference pre-LN implementation
validity_precondition: block_type='sequential' and norm_after=False (pre-LN)
evidence_from_issue: OLMoSequentialBlock attn_norm overwrites residual stream
evidence_from_fix: forward did `x = self.attn_norm(x)` clobbering residual stream so identity path uses normed x

semantic_objects: auxiliary loss term; loss normalization denominator
relation_statement: The auxiliary z-loss must be normalized by the token count (batch_size_in_tokens), consistently with the main loss normalization, when softmax_auxiliary_loss is enabled.
observable_signal: ratio of z_loss to cross-entropy loss is abnormally large and scales with batch_size_in_tokens/num_micro_batches
validity_precondition: softmax_auxiliary_loss=True and num_micro_batches != batch_size_in_tokens
evidence_from_issue: divides z_loss by num_micro_batches instead of batch_size_in_tokens
evidence_from_fix: z_loss = z_loss / num_micro_batches scales auxiliary loss by gradient accumulation count, not by token count; z_loss dominates loss and corrupts training

semantic_objects: sharded optimizer state (bias correction factor); parameter update
relation_statement: The bias-correction scaling applied to parameter updates must be identical across all subgroup invocations within the same optimizer step.
observable_signal: bias_correction2 values recorded per subgroup call differ within one step; per-subgroup update magnitudes inconsistent for identical moments
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with CPU-offloaded optimizer processing parameters in multiple subgroups per step
evidence_from_issue: CPUAdam 的 IncrementStep 在同一 step 内多次 subgroup 调用时，std::pow 路径与乘法路径产生不同的 bias_correction2 值
evidence_from_fix: std::pow 路径与乘法路径产生不同的 bias_correction2 值，导致参数更新不一致

semantic_objects: parameter tensor; optimizer state; fused-kernel element count
relation_statement: Parameters and optimizer state must change after an optimizer step with nonzero gradients, for tensors of any size including >= 2^31 elements.
observable_signal: parameter checksum and optimizer-state checksum identical before and after step while gradient norm is nonzero, for tensors with numel >= 2^31
validity_precondition: fused optimizer processing a tensor with >= 2^31 elements
evidence_from_issue: Integer overflow in FusedAdam silently prevents weight updates for large tensors (>= 2^31 elements)
evidence_from_fix: sizes 数组使用 int32，超过 2^31 个元素的 tensor 溢出为负值，CUDA kernel 循环不执行，参数和 optimizer state 不更新

semantic_objects: RNG state; recomputed activation; dropout mask
relation_statement: Activations recomputed during activation-checkpoint backward must equal the original forward activations after the saved RNG state is restored.
observable_signal: checksum of recomputed activations (or sampled dropout mask) differs between forward and recompute passes; loss progressively diverges from a non-compiled reference
validity_precondition: custom activation checkpointing combined with torch.compile and dropout active
evidence_from_issue: accuracy issue for torch.compile if activation checkpoint function not compiler disabled
evidence_from_fix: RNG state 保存/恢复机制不匹配导致 dropout 在 forward/backward 间产生不同随机数，loss 逐步发散

semantic_objects: accumulated gradient; replicated model parameter
relation_statement: All microbatch gradients, including the last one, must be included in the cross-rank allreduce so that post-reduction gradients and updated weights are identical across DP ranks.
observable_signal: gradient (or post-step parameter) checksum differs across DP ranks after the accumulation-boundary reduction
validity_precondition: bf16 with grad_accum_dtype=fp32, zero_stage=1, gradient_accumulation_steps > 1
evidence_from_issue: 最后一个 microbatch 的梯度被排除在 cross-rank allreduce 之外，各 rank 模型权重短暂发散
evidence_from_fix: backward_epilogue() called AFTER allreduce_gradients(). Last micro-batch FP32 grads not included in allreduce.

semantic_objects: optimizer step application; overflow flag
relation_statement: The optimizer step must apply parameter updates whenever no gradient overflow is detected; it may skip only on overflow.
observable_signal: parameters unchanged across steps while overflow flag is False and gradients are nonzero
validity_precondition: FP16 fused optimizer path; overflow check enabled
evidence_from_issue: return self.overflow 和 timer log 语句错位到 if self.overflow 块之外，导致无论是否溢出都提前返回
evidence_from_fix: return self.overflow at wrong indentation causes optimizer step to always return early

semantic_objects: gradient bucket; collective reduce operation; compute stream
relation_statement: Gradient writes on the producing CUDA stream must complete before the reduce-scatter reads the gradient buffer.
observable_signal: nondeterministic NaN or garbage values in reduced gradients; local pre-reduce gradient checksum disagrees with the values actually communicated
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 with backward executing on a non-default CUDA stream
evidence_from_issue: reduce-scatter 在梯度写入完成前就开始，产生随机 NaN
evidence_from_fix: reduce_and_partition_stream.wait_stream uses default_stream() instead of current_stream()

semantic_objects: expert mixture coefficients
relation_statement: Expert/MLP mixture coefficients must sum to one along the expert dimension for every token in residual MoE.
observable_signal: sum of softmax coefficients along the last (expert) dimension deviates from 1.0
validity_precondition: residual MoE layer with coefficient softmax active
evidence_from_issue: softmax 应用在错误的维度上，expert 和 MLP 的权重未在最后一个维度上正确归一化
evidence_from_fix: softmax(coef, dim=1) should be dim=-1 for correct expert coefficient normalization

semantic_objects: sharded parameter partition; checkpoint shard set
relation_statement: Every partition group's state must be persisted at save so that reload restores the full model state under MiCS sharding.
observable_signal: parameter checksums after save+load differ from pre-save values for ranks outside the first partition group; checkpoint file set missing shards
validity_precondition: MiCS sharding with more than one partition group
evidence_from_issue: MiCS 只有第一个 partition group 保存 checkpoint，其他 group 的数据丢失
evidence_from_fix: 加载时也缺少对 MiCS partition 的支持

semantic_objects: sharded optimizer state; checkpoint file; tensor slice bounds
relation_statement: A universal checkpoint written under multi-subgroup ZeRO-3 must round-trip: reloaded state must equal saved state with slices within bounds and no concurrent-writer corruption.
observable_signal: reloaded tensor slices out of bounds or checksum mismatch versus pre-save state; same checkpoint file written by multiple processes
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with multiple parameter subgroups; universal checkpoint format
evidence_from_issue: stage3 universal checkpoint 未正确处理多 subgroup 场景，tensor slicing 越界
evidence_from_fix: 多进程同时写入同一 checkpoint 文件导致竞争条件和数据损坏

semantic_objects: gradient accumulation buffer
relation_statement: Gradients must be accumulated in the configured high-precision dtype (fp32) rather than being forced to the low-precision model weight dtype under bf16 training.
observable_signal: runtime dtype of the gradient accumulation buffer equals bf16 instead of fp32; accumulated-gradient error grows with accumulation steps
validity_precondition: ZeRO enabled with bf16 model weights and gradient accumulation
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO 各 stage 强制梯度累积使用与模型权重相同的 dtype
evidence_from_fix: BF16 训练时梯度在 BF16 精度下累积导致数值不稳定

semantic_objects: configuration value (communication dtype); sequence-parallel communication buffer
relation_statement: The dtype actually used for sequence-parallel communication must equal the user-configured seq_parallel_communication_data_type value.
observable_signal: dtype of sequence-parallel collective buffers differs from the configured value; changing the config key produces no behavioral change
validity_precondition: sequence parallelism enabled and seq_parallel_communication_data_type explicitly set
evidence_from_issue: seq_parallel_communication_data_type config key typo causes silent ignore
evidence_from_fix: constant uses 'seq_parallel_comm_data_type' but config uses 'seq_parallel_communication_data_type'

semantic_objects: accumulated gradient partition; per-microbatch gradient
relation_statement: The accumulated gradient partition must equal the sum of all microbatch gradient contributions under manual gradient accumulation with CPU offload.
observable_signal: gradient norm under manual accumulation is systematically smaller than an equivalent large-batch reference; accumulated gradient equals only the last microbatch's contribution
validity_precondition: ZeRO-1/2 with CPU offload and manually driven gradient accumulation (micro_step_id > 0)
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-1/2 CPU-offload gradient norm underestimated with manual GA
evidence_from_fix: copy_grads_in_partition only accumulates when ga_steps > 1, misses micro_step_id > 0 case

semantic_objects: gradient bucket; collective reduce operation; compute stream
relation_statement: Gradient writes on the current compute stream must complete before the reduce-and-partition stream consumes the gradient bucket.
observable_signal: nondeterministic corruption/NaN in reduced gradient partitions; pre-reduce local gradient checksum disagrees with communicated values
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 with backward running on a non-default CUDA stream
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-3 reduce_and_partition_stream syncs against wrong CUDA stream
evidence_from_fix: __add_grad_to_ipg_bucket uses default_stream() instead of current_stream() for reduce_and_partition_stream synchronization

semantic_objects: optimizer state checkpoint metadata; checkpoint load path
relation_statement: Checkpoint save/load must classify the optimizer correctly (bf16 without ZeRO has no ZeRO partitioned state) so that reload restores exactly the state that was saved.
observable_signal: load path expects ZeRO-partitioned optimizer files that were never written, or restores wrong optimizer state; post-load optimizer state checksum mismatches pre-save
validity_precondition: bf16 training with ZeRO disabled; checkpoint save then load
evidence_from_issue: bf16 without ZeRO incorrectly treated as having ZeRO optimizer state in checkpoint
evidence_from_fix: (no root_cause text provided; inferred from title)

semantic_objects: high-precision master weights; low-precision model weights
relation_statement: After a module-only checkpoint load under bf16, the fp32 master weights must be refreshed to equal the upcast of the loaded bf16 module weights before training resumes.
observable_signal: checksum mismatch between fp32 master parameters and the upcast bf16 module parameters at the first step after load; master weights equal default initialization
validity_precondition: bf16 enabled and load_checkpoint(load_module_only=True, load_optimizer_states=False)
evidence_from_issue: load_module_only with bf16 silently skips refresh_fp32_params, optimizer trains on uninitialized fp32 weights
evidence_from_fix: the call to optimizer.refresh_fp32_params() was guarded by self.fp16_enabled(), so for bf16 the high-precision master weights were never refreshed from the loaded 16-bit module

semantic_objects: configuration value (communication dtype); gradient communication buffer
relation_statement: The reduce-scatter communication buffer must be cast to the user-configured communication_data_type whenever it differs from the model dtype.
observable_signal: dtype of the buffer entering reduce-scatter equals the model dtype instead of the configured communication dtype
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with communication_data_type != model dtype (e.g. fp32 comm with bf16 model)
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 communication_data_type comparison inverted — buffer cast happens only when no cast is needed
evidence_from_fix: the gate was `if self.communication_data_type == self.dtype:` — exactly backward. When the user requested a different communication dtype, the buffer was NOT cast

semantic_objects: sharded parameter; collective gather handle; parameter coordinator state
relation_statement: A sharded parameter may be consumed in forward only after its all-gather completes under the coordinator that issued it, including across train/eval mode switches.
observable_signal: parameter checksum in the first iteration after a train/eval switch differs from the correctly gathered full parameter; a gather handle is awaited that never fires or is re-issued while in flight
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with alternating model.train()/model.eval() inside a step and overlap_comm or prefetch enabled
evidence_from_issue: InflightParamRegistry shared between train and eval coordinators causes stale handles on mode switch
evidence_from_fix: in-flight allgather handles registered under one coordinator were observed by the other ... leading to silently-stale parameter values during the first iteration after the switch

semantic_objects: sparse gradient; parameter gradient slot
relation_statement: Post-allreduce sparse gradient values must be written back into the parameter's gradient consumed by the optimizer so sparse-embedding parameters are actually updated.
observable_signal: sparse embedding weights unchanged across steps while their upstream gradients are nonzero; param.grad still holds pre-reduction values
validity_precondition: module produces sparse gradients (e.g. embedding with sparse=True)
evidence_from_issue: Sparse gradients silently not updating — SparseTensor wraps .data instead of param.grad
evidence_from_fix: Python re-bound the local name and never wrote back into param.grad ... the sparse embedding gradients were silently dropped

semantic_objects: gradient reduction collective; gradient accumulation boundary flag
relation_statement: The cross-rank gradient reduction must fire exactly once per gradient-accumulation boundary, not once per micro-batch, under pipeline parallelism with ZeRO.
observable_signal: count of reduce/reduce-scatter operations per optimizer step equals the number of micro-batches instead of 1; accumulated gradient magnitude wrong versus a reference
validity_precondition: pipeline parallel combined with ZeRO stage 2 or 3 and gradient_accumulation_steps > 1
evidence_from_issue: gradient accumulation boundary flag never propagated, ZeRO does early reduction every micro-step
evidence_from_fix: ZeRO's internal `is_gradient_accumulation_boundary` therefore stayed at its default and reduction kicked off on every micro-batch

semantic_objects: expert (sharded) parameter; checkpoint sharding metadata
relation_statement: The replication-factor metadata written for expert checkpoints must equal the effective expert-data-parallel world size so that resume re-shards expert tensors into the same slices that were saved.
observable_signal: expert parameter checksums after resume differ from pre-save values; recorded dp_world_size in checkpoint disagrees with dp_size/sp_size
validity_precondition: MoE module present with sequence_parallel_size > 1; save then load checkpoint
evidence_from_issue: MoE checkpoint records dp_world_size instead of seq_dp_world_size — wrong replication factor on resume with sequence parallel
evidence_from_fix: On resume the checkpoint loader uses this value to re-shard expert tensors, producing the wrong split ... each EP-rank loads weights for the wrong slice

semantic_objects: gradient partition padding; reduce-scattered gradient partition
relation_statement: The reduce-scattered gradient partition must equal the element-wise sum across ranks of valid gradient values only, with padding elements contributing exactly zero.
observable_signal: nondeterministic gradient values in partitions adjacent to padded regions; gradient checksum varies across identical reruns; padding bytes nonzero before communication
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with any parameter whose last partition requires padding
evidence_from_issue: partition padding allocated with torch.empty — undefined values get reduced into other ranks' partitions
evidence_from_fix: built a padded_partition with `torch.empty(...)` and only copied the valid prefix ... other ranks received contaminated padding bytes mixed into the next parameter's region

semantic_objects: router gate weight (optimizer-managed parameter); forward-pass parameter binding
relation_statement: The gate weight used in forward must be the same storage as the optimizer/ZeRO-managed parameter so that its gradients are reduced and its updates are applied across steps.
observable_signal: gate weight checksum stays at its initialization value across steps while the gate receives nonzero gradients; forward-used tensor storage differs from the registered parameter
validity_precondition: MoE TopKGate with fp16/bf16 mixed precision under ZeRO (engine downcasts model parameters)
evidence_from_issue: TopKGate.wg silently rebound to a fresh fp32 Linear under ZeRO+fp16/bf16 — gate weight gradients never applied to the ZeRO-managed parameter
evidence_from_fix: The new wg.weight is NOT the ZeRO-tracked parameter, so its gradient is never reduced across ranks and the optimizer never updates it. The original wg.weight stays at its initialization value forever

semantic_objects: attention activation gradients
relation_statement: Attention backward outputs dQ/dK/dV under context parallelism must equal (within tolerance) those of an equivalent single-device execution.
observable_signal: relative error of dQ/dK/dV versus a CP=1 reference run exceeds tolerance (reported up to 1.2); requires a reference execution to witness
validity_precondition: core attention backward with context parallelism enabled
evidence_from_issue: dQ, dK, dV output from the backward function of core_attention are wrong when context parallelism is enabled
evidence_from_fix: Activation gradients have relative error as large as 1.2 compared to single-card training

semantic_objects: loss gradient scaling factor; per-chunk local loss
relation_statement: Backward gradients under context parallelism must use the chunk's local loss with no extra cp_size multiplication, matching the scaling of non-CP training.
observable_signal: gradient norm scales proportionally with cp_size relative to a CP=1 reference; gradients carry a spurious cp_size factor
validity_precondition: context-parallel loss backward path
evidence_from_issue: Loss is multiplied by cp_size in the backward pass, causing gradient outputs to differ from non-CP training
evidence_from_fix: The mul cp_size logic should be removed; gradients should use the chunk's local loss, not the all-reduced loss

semantic_objects: router gate parameter; routing probability
relation_statement: Router gate parameters must receive nonzero gradients (routing probabilities must not be a constant 1.0) when num_experts >= 2, so the router actually learns.
observable_signal: router weight gradient norm is exactly zero at every step; top-1 routing probability is identically 1.0 for all tokens
validity_precondition: num_experts >= 2 with moe_router_topk=1 and post-softmax (no pre-softmax) routing
evidence_from_issue: Megatron applies topk first then softmax ... producing different routing decisions
evidence_from_fix: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax of single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn.

semantic_objects: router jitter noise tensor; low-precision activation input
relation_statement: The jitter-multiplied router activation must preserve the input's low-precision dtype (bf16) rather than being promoted to fp32, under guard: MoE routing with input jitter enabled in mixed precision.
observable_signal: Output tensor dtype is fp32 while the input activation is bf16 (silent promotion).
validity_precondition: MoE TopKRouter with --moe-input-jitter-eps>0 under bf16/fp16 mixed precision.
evidence_from_issue: MoE router input jitter computation uses wrong dtype, causing numerical inconsistencies in expert routing.
evidence_from_fix: Uniform creates fp32 tensors by default; multiplying bf16 input by fp32 jitter silently promotes the result to fp32.

semantic_objects: gradient tensor; broadcast collective op; autograd graph
relation_statement: Gradients must propagate through the broadcast collective's registered autograd kernel (intact autograd graph) under guard: DP training with torch.compile inside a PPO loop.
observable_signal: Computed gradients differ from reference because the autograd graph is truncated at c10d::broadcast_ after the recompile limit is hit.
validity_precondition: PPO loop toggling requires_grad under torch.compile with c10d broadcast.
evidence_from_issue: requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit, breaking the autograd graph.
evidence_from_fix: c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients.

semantic_objects: learning rate scheduler state; optimizer hyperparameter
relation_statement: After checkpoint load with --override-opt_param-scheduler, the first-step learning rate must equal the newly configured schedule value, not the checkpoint's old value.
observable_signal: First post-load training step's LR equals the old checkpoint LR instead of the configured override.
validity_precondition: Resume from checkpoint with --override-opt_param-scheduler and a new LR set.
evidence_from_issue: first training step still uses the old learning rate from the checkpoint instead of the new configured value.
evidence_from_fix: After loading checkpoint with override and new LR setting, the first step uses the old LR from the checkpoint.

semantic_objects: gradient buffer; main gradient accumulator
relation_statement: The gradient buffer must be zero-initialized before accumulation so main gradients equal only the summed micro-batch gradients, under guard: first iteration with forward_pre_hook disabled.
observable_signal: First-iteration main_grad contains residual initial parameter values (non-zero before any backward accumulation).
validity_precondition: mxfp8 param all-gather with reuse_grad_buf when forward_pre_hook is disabled.
evidence_from_issue: finish_param_sync() is never called to zero the gradient buffer on the first iteration.
evidence_from_fix: initial parameter values pollute the main gradients silently.

semantic_objects: attention output gate tensor; sharded query/key/value partition
relation_statement: Under TP>1 the output gate must be sliced to match each rank's Q/K/V partition, so gate width equals the local partition width.
observable_signal: Gate tensor is applied at full (unsliced) width to a per-rank partition; attention output differs from the reference.
validity_precondition: self-attention with output_gate=True and num_query_groups < tensor_model_parallel_size.
evidence_from_issue: MoE/DSA gate not sliced when num_query_groups < tp_size.
evidence_from_fix: Each TP rank multiplied its Q/K/V partition by the full unsliced gate, producing wrong attention output but no error.

semantic_objects: computed gradient buffer (decoupled_grad); optimizer-read gradient
relation_statement: The optimizer must read gradients from the buffer where they are written (decoupled_grad), so parameter updates reflect the computed gradient, under guard: Megatron-FSDP + precision-aware FusedAdam.
observable_signal: Parameters stay unchanged across steps despite non-zero gradients because FusedAdam reads None/stale param.grad.
validity_precondition: use_megatron_fsdp + precision-aware optimizer + TE FusedAdam.
evidence_from_issue: FusedAdam.use_decoupled_grad not set for Megatron-FSDP, gradients silently ignored.
evidence_from_fix: use_decoupled_grad flag never set True, so the optimizer kept reading param.grad (None or stale), silently skipping the update.

semantic_objects: gathered expert parameters; param-sync completion flag
relation_statement: param_gather must mark dispatch/finish so expert parameters are refreshed to current values even when the intra distributed-optimizer instance size is 1.
observable_signal: Expert params remain at stale/uninitialized values from the previous step's gather buffer (param_gather_dispatched stays False, finish_param_sync never runs).
validity_precondition: layer-wise distributed optimizer with expt_dp_size==1 and MoE expert parameters.
evidence_from_issue: Layerwise distributed optimizer never marks param_gather as dispatched when expt_dp_size=1.
evidence_from_fix: all-gather handles list empty but param_gather_dispatched False; expert params left uninitialized/stale.

semantic_objects: MoE auxiliary loss tracker; router forward pass
relation_statement: The aux-loss accumulator must increment once per logical training forward, not additionally on activation-recompute passes, under guard: MoE router with activation checkpointing.
observable_signal: Logged aux loss is doubled (incremented in both the normal and the no-grad recompute pass).
validity_precondition: TopKRouter training=True with activation recompute/checkpointing enabled.
evidence_from_issue: MoE aux loss tracker accumulates twice when activation checkpointing reruns router.
evidence_from_fix: router only checked self.training, not torch.is_grad_enabled(); tracker incremented in both passes, doubling logged values.

semantic_objects: fp32 residual stream tensor; bf16 activation tensor
relation_statement: The residual add must upcast the activation to the residual's fp32 dtype (preserving fp32), not downcast the residual to bf16.
observable_signal: Residual/output tensor dtype is bf16 instead of fp32 after bias-dropout-add.
validity_precondition: mixed-precision training with an fp32 residual connection.
evidence_from_issue: fp32 residual connection silently downcast to bf16.
evidence_from_fix: _bias_dropout_add_func downcasts residual to x.dtype (bf16) instead of upcasting x to residual.dtype (fp32).

semantic_objects: token-to-expert routing index map; expert dispatch layout
relation_statement: Local expert index selection must preserve the (token, expert_slot) layout under guard: MoE dispatch with topk>1 and EP>1.
observable_signal: Tokens dispatched to wrong experts on each EP rank; fancy-indexed local_indices differ from the masked_select ordering.
validity_precondition: BaseMoELayer dispatch with moe_router_topk>1 and expert_parallel_size>1.
evidence_from_issue: MoE local_indices wrong via fancy indexing on bool mask when topk > 1.
evidence_from_fix: advanced indexing collapses dims and breaks the (token, expert_slot) layout; masked_select preserves the correct flat ordering.

semantic_objects: MoE expert token activations across TP ranks; GroupedGEMM output
relation_statement: MoE GroupedGEMM output must be correct regardless of whether sequence_parallel is on, which requires the expert-token gather/scatter across TP ranks whenever TP>1.
observable_signal: With TP>1, SP=False, EP=1 each TP rank produces incomplete MoE output differing from the SP=True reference.
validity_precondition: MoE with GroupedGEMM experts, TP>1, sequence_parallel=False.
evidence_from_issue: MoE GroupedGEMM produces wrong outputs without sequence_parallel even when TP>1.
evidence_from_fix: neither sequence_parallel nor expert_parallel True, so expert tokens were never gathered across TP ranks.

semantic_objects: per-bucket gradient slice; gradient scaling factor
relation_statement: Gradient scaling must divide each bucket by 1/dp_size exactly once (operating on bucket.data), not divide the whole buffer once per bucket, under Megatron-FSDP with multiple buckets.
observable_signal: Reduced gradients scaled by (1/dp_size)**num_buckets instead of 1/dp_size, with no shape mismatch.
validity_precondition: use_megatron_fsdp with multiple buckets per gradient buffer and scaling factor != 1.
evidence_from_issue: GradReducePipeline scales gbuf.data instead of bucket.data, applying scaling to the wrong tensor span.
evidence_from_fix: passed gbuf.data (entire buffer) instead of bucket.data (per-bucket slice), giving cumulative scaling (1/dp_size)**num_buckets.

semantic_objects: reduced gradient; gradient scaling factor
relation_statement: The gradient scaling factor must be 1/(dp_size*cp_size) when context parallel is enabled, matching the dp*cp span of the reduction collective.
observable_signal: Gradients divided only by dp_size, leaving a residual over-scaling factor of cp_size in parameter updates.
validity_precondition: context_parallel_size>1, sample-mean loss (calculate_per_token_loss=False), DistributedOptimizer/average_in_collective.
evidence_from_issue: target_gradient_scaling_factor uses get_data_parallel_world_size without context_parallel, over-scaling by cp_size.
evidence_from_fix: reduction spans dp*cp ranks so gradients should be divided by dp_size*cp_size; dividing by dp_size only leaves a factor of cp_size.

semantic_objects: async P2P send buffer; next-stage received activation
relation_statement: The async P2P send must be waited on before its source buffer is deallocated, so the next pipeline stage receives the intended activations.
observable_signal: Next-stage received activation is corrupted because the buffer is reused before the isend HtoD copy completes.
validity_precondition: interleaved 1F1B with deallocate_pipeline_outputs=True and async P2P (overlap_p2p_communication).
evidence_from_issue: Interleaved 1F1B forgets to wait on async P2P send before deallocating the source buffer, sending corrupted activations.
evidence_from_fix: issued isend then immediately called deallocate_output_tensor without waiting on send_next_wait_handle.

semantic_objects: all-gathered input activation tensor; wgrad GEMM kernel input
relation_statement: The gathered input handed to the wgrad GEMM must be contiguous, because the kernel indexes via flat data_ptr arithmetic, under guard: SP+TP>1 with grad-accumulation fusion.
observable_signal: wgrad accumulation produces silently wrong numbers when a strided (non-contiguous) tensor is passed even though tensor metadata looks valid.
validity_precondition: sequence parallel + TP>1 with non-contiguous gathered activations (e.g. NeMo SFT QAT) and grad-accumulation fusion.
evidence_from_issue: prepare_input_tensors_for_wgrad_compute does not enforce all_gathered_input.contiguous(); wgrad GEMM reads a strided tensor as contiguous.
evidence_from_fix: kernel indexes the buffer via flat data_ptr arithmetic and reads the wrong elements while metadata looks valid.

semantic_objects: gradient buffer for norm (decoupled_grad); global gradient norm
relation_statement: Grad norm must be computed from decoupled_grad (not param.grad._local_tensor) when both Megatron-FSDP and precision-aware optimizer are on, so the norm reflects the real gradients.
observable_signal: Global grad norm computed as ~0/wrong; gradient clipping silently disabled and logged norm incorrect.
validity_precondition: Megatron-FSDP params (__fsdp_param__) + precision-aware optimizer (decoupled grads) + grad clipping.
evidence_from_issue: get_grads_for_norm checks fsdp_param BEFORE precision-aware branch, reading param.grad._local_tensor instead of decoupled_grad.
evidence_from_fix: under precision-aware optimizer param.grad is None/stale, so the norm used wrong (likely zero) tensors, disabling clipping.

semantic_objects: attention softmax scale factor; attention scores
relation_statement: Attention scores must be scaled by the configured config.softmax_scale rather than the default 1/sqrt(head_dim).
observable_signal: Attention logits scaled by the default factor; configured softmax_scale has no effect on the output.
validity_precondition: attention forward paths when config.softmax_scale is set.
evidence_from_issue: config.softmax_scale ignored in attention forward paths.

semantic_objects: learning rate schedule; scheduler initialization state
relation_statement: The realized learning rate at each step must conform to the CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay schedule from correct initialization.
observable_signal: Realized LR curve deviates from the expected warmup + cosine + linear-decay schedule.
validity_precondition: training with the CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler.
evidence_from_issue: CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay 学习率 scheduler 的初始化逻辑错误，导致学习率 schedule 不符合预期
evidence_from_fix: Fixed CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler initialization bug

semantic_objects: in-place set_ operation; compiled computation graph
relation_statement: torch.compile CSE must not eliminate expressions following an unfunctionalized set_, so the mutation's effect on FSDP results is preserved.
observable_signal: Compiled result differs from eager because CSE removed the repeated expression after set_.
validity_precondition: FSDP set_ under torch.compile with CSE optimization.
evidence_from_issue: FSDP 的 set_ 操作未被 functionalized，torch.compile 的 CSE 优化错误地消除了 set_ 之后的重复表达式，导致静默产生错误结果
evidence_from_fix: set_ not functionalized; CSE eliminated the duplicate expression after set_, silently producing wrong results.

semantic_objects: bf16 gradient; gradient reduction/accumulation dtype
relation_statement: FSDP gradient reduction/accumulation must be performed in fp32, not the bf16 reduce_dtype, to remain numerically stable at scale.
observable_signal: bf16 reduction accumulation error; training instability/divergence at 48x8 GPU scale.
validity_precondition: FSDP with bf16 reduce_dtype at large scale.
evidence_from_issue: FSDP 使用 bf16 reduce_dtype 时，梯度的 accumulation/reduction 在 bf16 精度下进行，大规模训练变得不稳定
evidence_from_fix: gradient accumulation/reduction done in bf16 causes instability; needs fp32 accumulation.

semantic_objects: initialized parameter; sharded parameter layout
relation_statement: Parameter initialization via param_init_fn must yield the same RNG stream/values regardless of flatten/shard, and with sync_module_states be identical across ranks.
observable_signal: Re-init after flatten/shard changes parameter shape, altering the RNG sequence; model shows random accuracy (not learning) with no error.
validity_precondition: FSDP with param_init_fn and sync_module_states=True.
evidence_from_issue: FSDP 使用 param_init_fn 和 sync_module_states=True 时，re-initialization 在 flatten/shard 后改变参数 shape 导致 RNG 序列不同，模型无法学习但不报错
evidence_from_fix: re-init after flatten/shard changes shape so RNG sequence differs; params effectively not learning.

semantic_objects: gradient-norm EMA state; adaptive clipping threshold
relation_statement: The grad-norm EMA update must combine the previous EMA and the current grad norm (ema = beta*ema_prev + (1-beta)*x), not update self-referentially.
observable_signal: grad_norm_exp_avg degenerates/diverges from the true running grad-norm average; adaptive clipping threshold is wrong.
validity_precondition: adaptive gradient clipping using a grad-norm EMA.
evidence_from_issue: grad_norm_exp_avg EMA self-referential update — adaptive clipping broken.

semantic_objects: attention mask bias tensor; softmax input
relation_statement: Masked-position bias must use finfo(target_dtype).min and be cast before the SDP call, so no -inf survives downcast to produce NaN under autocast.
observable_signal: NaNs appear in the attention output after softmax on masked/padded tokens under bf16/fp16 autocast.
validity_precondition: AMP/autocast (bf16/fp16), padded sequences requiring masking, scaled_dot_product_attention.
evidence_from_issue: SDP attention bias not cast to autocast dtype, -inf downcasts to NaNs in mixed precision.
evidence_from_fix: downcasting -inf to bf16/fp16 yields -inf that produces NaNs after softmax; fix uses finfo(dtype).min and casts before SDP.

semantic_objects: cumulative FLOPs/token counter; speed-monitor accumulator
relation_statement: The cumulative FLOPs counter must accumulate per token and increase monotonically across steps and resumes, not be reset/overwritten each step.
observable_signal: Reported Gflops does not accumulate across resumes (running total reset per step) and mismatches cumulative tokens.
validity_precondition: speed/flops monitoring, especially after resume from a checkpoint.
evidence_from_issue: FLOPs counter multiplies per-sequence flops by global batch size every step instead of accumulating per token.
evidence_from_fix: after resume the running total was overwritten/reset per step; fix makes flops per-token and Gflops cumulative over global_total_tokens.

semantic_objects: optimizer step guard; outlier-loss detector flag
relation_statement: The optimizer must step iff the batch is not an outlier; stepping and outlier-skipping must be mutually exclusive and correctly aligned.
observable_signal: Optimizer steps only on outlier batches and silently skips normal batches (should_step AND-ed with is_outlier).
validity_precondition: ce_loss_outlier_detector or grad_norm_outlier_detector enabled.
evidence_from_issue: Outlier-loss skip-step logic inverted: optimizer steps only when loss IS an outlier.
evidence_from_fix: should_step AND-ed with is_outlier; fix negates is_outlier so the optimizer steps on normal batches and skips outliers.

semantic_objects: device-selection guard; runtime compute device
relation_statement: The device-selection guard must evaluate the real predicate (torch.backends.mps.is_available()), so the chosen device matches available hardware instead of always resolving to MPS.
observable_signal: On a CUDA host, init_device is forced to 'mps' and distributed training is disabled because torch.device('mps') is always truthy.
validity_precondition: scripts/train.py entrypoint device selection on any backend (CUDA/MPS/CPU).
evidence_from_issue: torch.device('mps') used as boolean check is always truthy, forces every run into MPS/CPU mode.
evidence_from_fix: torch.device(...) returns a non-None Device so the check is always True; fix uses torch.backends.mps.is_available() plus a CPU check.

semantic_objects: readout layer weights; parameter initialization scheme
relation_statement: The output readout weights must retain the muP zero initialization so that the model's output scale at init is invariant across model widths when use_mup is enabled.
observable_signal: nonzero L2 norm of the readout weight immediately after initialization; muP coordinate-check activation curves diverging across widths
validity_precondition: use_mup=True and the module is the final output readout (readout-parameterized layer); reset_parameters invoked
evidence_from_issue: ff_out readout reset overwrites muP zero-init weights with normal-distribution values
evidence_from_fix: Fix skips init_normal on ff_out when use_mup is True; non-zero init breaks the muP coordinate-check property and changes the effective output scale

semantic_objects: per-block feedforward projection weights; parameter initialization scheme
relation_statement: Every transformer block's FFN projection weights must carry the prescribed non-zero normal initialization scale (only the final readout is zero-initialized) when muP is enabled.
observable_signal: per-layer weight std equal to 0 for block FFN projections after init; block FFN output identically zero at the start of training
validity_precondition: use_mup=True; applies to every block's internal FFN projection, not the final readout
evidence_from_issue: OLMoSequentialBlock.ff_proj is silently zero-initialized via MuReadout when use_mup is enabled; wipes out the FFN contribution at start of training
evidence_from_fix: Fix only uses MuReadout for ff_proj when mlp_hidden_size is also set and always re-initializes ff_proj via init_normal

semantic_objects: attention logit scale factor; parameterization scheme
relation_statement: The attention temperature under muP must equal the standard-parameterization value 1/sqrt(d) whenever the head count equals the muP base width, and track muP scaling rules otherwise.
observable_signal: attention logits/outputs differing between muP and SP runs at the base width on identical inputs; scale constant equal to 1/d instead of sqrt(base_heads)/d
validity_precondition: use_mup=True on the scaled-dot-product attention path (not flash varlen)
evidence_from_issue: muP attention scale uses 1/d instead of sqrt(base_d)/d, mismatching the SP scale at the base width
evidence_from_fix: Fix uses sqrt(mup_base_n_heads)/q.size(-1) so the scale matches SP exactly when n_heads == mup_base_n_heads

semantic_objects: training step counter; learning-rate scheduler state; checkpoint resume mode
relation_statement: After a weights-only resume (restore_dataloader=False), all training-progress counters including the global step must be set to the fresh-run value 0 so the LR scheduler replays warmup.
observable_signal: global step nonzero at the first iteration of the new run; initial learning rate far from the expected warmup start value
validity_precondition: resuming from a checkpoint with restore_dataloader=False, i.e. a new run starting from saved weights
evidence_from_issue: global_step not reset when restore_dataloader=False, so resumed runs keep the checkpoint's step counter
evidence_from_fix: restore_checkpoint() resets epoch and token counters but forgot to reset global_step; scheduler starts at e.g. 50000 instead of 0, silently skipping warmup and using a much smaller LR

semantic_objects: reduced gradient/parameter norm metrics; model replica group
relation_statement: Metrics all-reduced with SUM across identical model replicas must be divided by the replica count so the logged value equals the true single-replica value.
observable_signal: logged per-param averages and grad-norm metrics exactly num_model_replicas times a single-replica recomputation
validity_precondition: hybrid-sharded data parallelism with num_model_replicas>1 and param-metric collection enabled
evidence_from_issue: Reduced sums/norms not divided by num_model_replicas in HSDP, optimizer metrics inflated by replica count
evidence_from_fix: Fix divides the all-reduced tensors (all_sums_norms_numels and all_norms) by self.num_model_replicas before splitting and using

semantic_objects: readout-parameterized projection weights; parameter initialization scheme
relation_statement: Weights constructed as muP readout modules must retain the muP-prescribed zero/special initialization so activation magnitudes remain width-invariant when use_mup is enabled.
observable_signal: readout-parameterized weight statistics matching a truncated normal instead of the muP zero init right after reset_parameters; coordinate-check activation magnitudes drifting with width
validity_precondition: use_mup enabled (or an init scheme expecting readout zero-init) and block reset_parameters invoked
evidence_from_issue: Block readout init unconditionally re-initializes ff_proj, overwriting muP zero-init
evidence_from_fix: unconditional init_normal overwrites the MuReadout initialization, silently breaking the muP coordinate-check guarantee that activation magnitudes are width-independent

semantic_objects: query normalization module; key normalization module; normalization affine configuration flag
relation_statement: The constructed q-norm and k-norm modules must both honor the configured elementwise-affine flag so query and key normalization are structurally symmetric under the requested configuration.
observable_signal: learnable affine parameters present in the q-norm while absent in the k-norm when the affine flag is False; parameter count exceeding the configured model
validity_precondition: QK normalization enabled with elementwise affine disabled in the config
evidence_from_issue: q_norm forced to elementwise_affine=True regardless of attention_layer_norm_with_affine
evidence_from_fix: k_norm correctly used elementwise_affine=config.attention_layer_norm_with_affine but q_norm was hard-coded to True, breaking symmetry between q and k and adding parameters the user did not request

semantic_objects: readout layer weights; meta-device initialization pipeline; parameter device placement
relation_statement: The readout weight's initialization statistics must match the configured init scheme delivered through the meta-device materialization path, not the framework default, when init_device is meta.
observable_signal: readout weight std deviating from the configured init std after materialization; readout parameter residing on a real device while all other parameters are on the meta device
validity_precondition: init_device='meta' with sharded-data-parallel lazy materialization expected
evidence_from_issue: ff_out nn.Linear constructed without device=init_device, breaking meta-init flow
evidence_from_fix: omitting the device kwarg meant ff_out was built on the default device with default kaiming init, escaping the init pipeline; the readout carries the wrong init scale

semantic_objects: materialized model parameters; parameter initialization routine; parameterization branch
relation_statement: After model materialization, parameter statistics must match the configured init distribution regardless of which parameterization branch (muP with infshapes vs SP baseline) is taken.
observable_signal: parameter statistics stuck at framework-default (often near-zero) values instead of the configured init distribution after loading in the SP branch
validity_precondition: coord-check load_model path used for the standard-parameterization baseline, i.e. infshapes is None
evidence_from_issue: load_model in mup coord-check skips reset_parameters when infshapes is None
evidence_from_fix: reset_parameters() was nested inside `if infshapes is not None:`; the SP baseline skipped it entirely, leaving FSDP-materialized parameters at default values; curves look completely off without raising an error

semantic_objects: learning-rate schedule; scheduler configuration
relation_statement: The learning rate must monotonically decrease after warmup according to the intended warmup-then-decay schedule.
observable_signal: logged learning rate constant at the peak value for every post-warmup step instead of decaying
validity_precondition: trainer configured with a warmup+decay schedule and training long enough that the decay phase matters
evidence_from_issue: DeepSpeed scheduler set to WarmupLR instead of WarmupDecayLR (no decay phase)
evidence_from_fix: WarmupLR only ramps to max LR then holds it constant; the intended WarmupDecayLR ramps then linearly decays; training runs at peak LR for the entire post-warmup duration

semantic_objects: residual stream input; attention normalization output
relation_statement: The block's residual input must remain unmodified by the attention normalization so the block output equals the input plus the transformed branch (identity path preserved).
observable_signal: checksum of the block input tensor changing across the normalization call (in-place overwrite); block output no longer equal to x + f(norm(x))
validity_precondition: pre-norm residual transformer block with an attention normalization preceding the residual add
evidence_from_issue: Attention norm overwrites residual input — destroys identity path
evidence_from_fix: none provided (root_cause field empty)

semantic_objects: attention projection weights; initialization standard deviation; weight fan-in dimension
relation_statement: Each attention weight's initialization std must scale with that weight's own actual fan-in (in_features**-0.5), not a single model-width constant, under the fan-in-based init method.
observable_signal: empirical post-init weight std of the output projection and K/V projections deviating from in_features**-0.5 when fan-in differs from d_model
validity_precondition: fan-in-scaled init method selected; grouped-query attention (n_kv_heads != n_heads) or output projection whose fan-in differs from d_model
evidence_from_issue: Attention init uses d_model**-0.5 instead of actual w.in_features**-0.5 — wrong std for GQA Q/K/V and w_out
evidence_from_fix: a single std = d_model**-0.5 assumed identical fan-in across all weights; for w_out the actual fan-in is n_heads*head_dim which can differ from d_model; initialization silently scaled wrong

semantic_objects: stored token buffer dtype; dataset reader dtype; token id stream
relation_statement: The integer dtype used to read token files must equal the dtype the tokens were stored with whenever the tokenizer vocabulary requires the wider type.
observable_signal: token count per file double the expected length; token-id distribution inconsistent with the source corpus and vocabulary statistics
validity_precondition: tokenizer vocab exceeds 65535 (tokens stored as uint32) and the data source config leaves token_dtype at its default
evidence_from_issue: reads dolma2 (uint32) tokens with default uint16 dtype — silently produces garbage token ids
evidence_from_fix: reading the file as uint16 reinterprets each pair of bytes as a different token, so the model trained on totally fabricated token streams without any error

semantic_objects: configuration object; serialized config dictionary; derived non-init fields
relation_statement: A configuration must round-trip through encode/decode to an equivalent object, with derived (init=False) fields recomputed on decode rather than restored from a stale snapshot.
observable_signal: decode(encode(cfg)) not equal to cfg — derived field values differing from their post-init recomputation, or constructor failure on unexpected kwargs
validity_precondition: config dataclass declares field(init=False) derived fields and is serialized via as_dict then re-decoded
evidence_from_issue: Config encoding ignores field.init=False — non-init dataclass fields silently round-trip with stale values
evidence_from_fix: as_dict dumped derived fields and re-passed them on decode, which either crashed on unknown kwargs or silently overwrote the post_init-derived value with a stale snapshot, breaking round-trip equivalence

semantic_objects: activation cast dtype; wrapped parameter dtype
relation_statement: Input activations must be cast to the module's current parameter dtype at call time, not a construction-time snapshot, whenever a wrapper changes parameter dtype after construction.
observable_signal: activation dtype entering the kernel differing from the live conv weight dtype at runtime
validity_precondition: sequence-mixer module wrapped by a sharding wrapper (FSDP/FSDP2) with mixed-precision parameters after construction
evidence_from_issue: Mamba.forward casts inputs using cached self.dtype — wrong dtype after FSDP wraps the conv1d weight
evidence_from_fix: self.dtype was a construction-time snapshot; after FSDP wrapped the inner conv1d the actual parameter dtype changed, so x flowed into the kernel in the wrong precision and produced silently wrong values

semantic_objects: gated feedforward output; gate projection branch
relation_statement: The gated-FFN output must include the multiplicative gate branch, i.e. both projections must contribute to the computed output when a SwiGLU FFN is configured.
observable_signal: gate projection weights receiving zero gradient; module output invariant to perturbations of the gate projection weights
validity_precondition: boundary-predictor FFN configured as a standard SwiGLU (silu(w1(h)) * w3(h))
evidence_from_issue: calls F.silu with two arguments — silu treats w3(h) as inplace flag, drops gating
evidence_from_fix: the intended SwiGLU gate (silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)) never executed, so the FFN computed silu(w1(h)) alone and the boundary predictor produced silently degraded outputs

semantic_objects: learning-rate decay multiplier; training progress fraction
relation_statement: During the decay phase the learning-rate multiplier must decrease with training progress following the intended 1-sqrt(1-progress) curve shape.
observable_signal: logged learning rate rising (or with inverted curvature) as progress increases during the decay phase
validity_precondition: sqrt-style decay schedule selected and training within the decay phase
evidence_from_issue: sqrt decay LR schedule uses wrong formula — decay curve inverted
evidence_from_fix: sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress) — wrong decay curve shape

semantic_objects: output-head gradient accumulator; gradient accumulation dtype
relation_statement: Gradient accumulation inside the fused linear+cross-entropy kernel must be performed in fp32 so results match the unfused fp32-accumulation baseline within tolerance under bf16 training.
observable_signal: accumulation dtype bf16 at kernel invocation; loss/gradient trajectories on the LM head diverging from the unfused baseline beyond fp32-accumulation tolerance
validity_precondition: fused linear+CE loss implementation selected under bf16 mixed-precision training
evidence_from_issue: fused_linear_cross_entropy_loss accumulates gradient in bf16 by default — silently noisier than fp32 accumulation
evidence_from_fix: the fused call defaulted accum_grad to bf16, silently degrading gradient precision on the LM head; noise was small enough that training continued but it shifted loss curves vs the unfused baseline

semantic_objects: gradient norm metric; distributed tensor reduction; metric recording pipeline
relation_statement: The recorded grad-norm metric must equal the already globally-reduced clipping norm; no additional cross-rank reduction may be applied to it under tensor parallelism.
observable_signal: logged grad-norm differing from the unwrapped full-tensor norm computed at clip time; metric value changing with TP degree while the applied clipping does not
validity_precondition: gradient-clipping callback active with a max-norm configured and TP enabled
evidence_from_issue: Grad clipper recorded grad_norm DTensor — record_metric saw distributed value
evidence_from_fix: with TP clip_grad_norm_ returned a DTensor; the metric system operated on it across ranks, producing a wrongly reduced grad-norm value while clipping itself was already applied locally

semantic_objects: per-token loss sum; loss normalization denominator; data-parallel group
relation_statement: The global loss must equal the sum of per-token losses divided by the global count of loss-contributing tokens across the data-parallel group, even when some ranks mask out instances.
observable_signal: loss/gradient magnitude varying with how masked instances are distributed across ranks; per-rank divisor not summing to the global kept-token count
validity_precondition: instance mask present in the batch and at least one rank has masked-out instances; per-rank sum-then-allreduce loss reduction
evidence_from_issue: Instance filter loss divisor missed masked-out instance tokens — wrong gradient scale
evidence_from_fix: ranks with fewer kept tokens contributed an artificially large per-token loss, producing an unfair weighted average across the data-parallel group and a wrong gradient magnitude

semantic_objects: packed-document attention mask; cross-document attention interactions; document boundary offsets
relation_statement: Tokens belonging to different documents packed into one sequence must not attend to each other when document-length offsets are provided to the attention backend.
observable_signal: output of a packed sequence differing from per-document unpacked outputs; nonzero attention mass across document boundaries
validity_precondition: attention backend invoked with sequence packing and per-document cumulative lengths supplied
evidence_from_issue: TE attention backend silently ignored cu_doc_lens — intra-doc masking not applied
evidence_from_fix: forward accepted cu_doc_lens / max_doc_len but did not pass them to the kernel; documents packed into a single sequence cross-attended each other — full attention across all packed docs

semantic_objects: sliding-window attention mask; query-key position offsets
relation_statement: Attended key positions must be bounded within the configured two-sided window around each query position when sliding-window attention is enabled.
observable_signal: mask admitting key positions beyond one side of the configured window; attention output mismatching a dense reference with the correct two-sided window mask
validity_precondition: flex-attention backend selected with a sliding window configured
evidence_from_issue: sliding-window mask used Python `and` on tensors — short-circuit returned wrong mask
evidence_from_fix: Python's `and` short-circuits on bool() of the first operand, never producing the intended logical AND; the mask was computed as a single one-sided comparison

semantic_objects: frozen parameter set; shared teacher-student blocks; optimizer update set
relation_statement: Parameters designated as frozen (teacher-owned shared blocks) must be excluded from gradient updates during stage-1 distillation training.
observable_signal: checksums/norms of intended-frozen block parameters changing across optimizer steps; nonzero gradients accumulated on the frozen set
validity_precondition: distillation stage-1 with transformer blocks shared between teacher and student and a freeze pattern configured
evidence_from_issue: BLT stage1 froze only teacher.* — student blocks updated against teacher gradient
evidence_from_fix: because blocks are shared, the actual block parameters live under 'blocks.*' and were not matched by the freeze pattern, so they were unfrozen and trained against gradients including the teacher path

semantic_objects: byte-level loss component; patch-level loss component; loss normalization denominators
relation_statement: Each distillation loss component must be divided by its own position count (byte positions for the byte loss, patch positions for the patch loss) so the components are weighted as configured.
observable_signal: ratio of byte-loss to patch-loss contributions deviating from the configured weighting; divisor equal to the raw input element count instead of the component's position count
validity_precondition: distillation transformer with a patch-loss division factor configured
evidence_from_issue: BLTDistill patch loss div factor used input_ids.numel() — wrong scaling for byte-level losses
evidence_from_fix: the correct denominator is the number of byte positions, with an analogous division by patch positions for the patch loss; the mismatch silently mis-weighted byte vs patch loss components

semantic_objects: cached dataset index; dataset configuration fingerprint; sequence layout parameters
relation_statement: Dataset instances served from an on-disk cache must structurally match the active configuration, which requires the cache fingerprint to include every layout-determining field (sequence length, BOS token, max target length).
observable_signal: returned instance layout/length not matching the configured sequence length; cache hit despite a changed layout-determining setting
validity_precondition: fixed-sequence-length dataset variants with cached offsets/packed indices reused across runs whose sequence settings changed
evidence_from_issue: FSLDataset fingerprint missed sequence_length / bos_token_id — wrong cache reused
evidence_from_fix: cached instance offsets computed under previous values were reused when those settings changed, so the dataset returned instances whose actual layout no longer matched the configured sequence_length

semantic_objects: combined training loss; autograd graph connectivity; detached loss components
relation_statement: The loss tensor passed to backward must remain attached to the computation graph so that every configured loss component contributes gradient for all values of the mixing coefficient.
observable_signal: gradient norm collapsing to ~0 while the reported loss stays finite as the soft-loss weight decays; combined-loss components lacking grad_fn
validity_precondition: soft-CE distillation branch active while the head returns its CE and z-loss terms as detached copies
evidence_from_issue: soft_ce branch backprops only alpha*soft_ce — hard_ce gradient zeroed because output.ce_loss is detached
evidence_from_fix: combined_loss was built from .detach()'d ce_loss/z_loss; only output.loss carries gradient, so once alpha decayed to 0 backward() saw zero gradient and grad_norm collapsed
